editorial.blurb: A lively ramen and whisky spot where expertly crafted noodle bowls meet carefully made cocktails in a casual, energetic setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Order appetizers like pork belly buns and beef gyoza alongside your ramen—they arrive quickly and pair perfectly with their signature cocktails like the Yuzu Sake.
signatureDishes: Chicken shio ramen with fried garlic
